results.answer: For VAT201 returns, you need to send your sales and purchase invoices and bank statements by the 10th of the following month. If you send documents after that cut-off, we may not be able to submit by the SARS due date, and any SARS penalties and interest are your responsibility. Please contact us if you have questions about your own situation.

results.answer: If you do not answer bookkeeping queries within 5 working days, we will park the unclear items in a suspense account so the month can close. Parked items can distort your management report until they are resolved, so it is best to reply to queries promptly.

results.answer: Forward the letter to us within 2 working days. SARS letters often have response deadlines of 21 business days, and the clock starts when SARS sends the letter, not when you read it. We will log the letter, note the deadline, tell you what SARS is asking for, collect the documents needed, and prepare a response for your approval before submitting it on eFiling. We never ignore a SARS letter. Please don't email ID copies or bank statements in plain email, and never share your eFiling password. A consultant can review your specific letter.

results.answer: Our invoices are payable within 14 days. We accept EFT only, and you should use your invoice number as the payment reference. If you disagree with an invoice, let us know within 7 days of receiving it.

results.answer: For a company's annual financial statements we ask for: bank statements for all company accounts for the full financial year; sales invoices and a debtors list at year end; supplier invoices and a creditors list at year end; payroll records (payslips, EMP201 and EMP501 reconciliation, IRP5 summary); VAT201 returns and proof of payment; loan agreements and statements, including director and shareholder loans; a fixed asset register with purchases and disposals; and stock count sheets if the company holds stock. We also need company records such as the CIPC annual return and latest registration certificate, minutes of directors' and shareholders' meetings, the share register and any share transfers, and details of any changes to directors or the registered address. You send these by our late-documents deadline, and we then reconcile them, prepare draft statements for the directors to approve in writing, and submit the ITR14 to SARS.
sources: Document Checklist: Company Annual Financial Statements > Records we need

results.answer: Our checklist for an individual tax return says a home office claim needs an employer confirmation that you must work from home, the floor area of the office and of the home, and your monthly costs. Whether you can claim is a personal tax question, so a consultant should review your situation.
